bullets: FAST RELIEF ELECTROLYTE TABLETS: Medi-Lyte Electrolyte Replenisher provides quick relief from heat stress, fatigue and muscle cramping due to minerals lost to heat and perspiration; Easy-to-swallow tablets are perfect for workouts and hot climates

IMPROVE HYDRATION: These sugar-free electrolytes aid hydration beyond drinking fluids alone; Calcium (10.64 mg), Potassium (40 mg), and Magnesium (12 mg) replenish lost minerals without overdrinking or excessive sugar content

CRAMP RELIEF ON-THE-GO: Easy-to-carry foil packets (50 packs of 2 electrolyte pills) fit in gym bags, pockets, and purses; Take these hot weather essentials hiking, cycling, or to the worksite for rapid relief when needed

NO MIXING, NO MESS: Unlike powder-based electrolyte packets that require mixing with water and can leave a mess, Easy-to-swallow, film coated tablets deliver heat relief without any complicated steps or measuring

SUGAR-FREE, NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS: Contains zero sugar, sodium, and lactose, making these electrolyte tablets ideal for athletes, outdoor enthusiasts, and anyone managing their sugar intake; Gluten-free and formulated with no artificial flavors or fillers
